structured.feedback: The description is about 180 words, uses clear Markdown subheadings and ends with a call to action. It has no links or invented quotes, and it leaves out the fit and strap-width complaints. Its claims match the listing and reviews (clips on bra straps, slides for coverage, white, tan and black). The feature-versus-benefit split is blended, "jackets" is a small unsupported addition, and the trailing note is extra, but these are minor.
